name: PESTEC
recent: Pestec 近期面临 Shandong Power Equipment (SPECO) 提出的清盘呈请，涉及 1000 万美元企业担保，公司已取得临时禁令阻止对方执行担保。同时，公司委任前砂拉越警察总监 Mancha Ata 进入董事会，并有多项董事及大股东持股变动申报。最新季度财报显示净亏损 1731 万令吉。
notable: 公司委任前砂拉越警察总监 Dato Mancha Anak Ata 进入董事会。
公司取得高庭临时禁令，阻止中国供应商 SPECO 执行 1000 万美元企业担保。
公司就 SPECO 提出的清盘呈请向 Bursa 作出澄清，称此前未接获通知。
risks: SPECO 针对公司提出清盘呈请，涉及 1000 万美元企业担保。
公司收到清盘 / 接管 / 限制令 / 特别管理公告。
董事及大股东 Datuk Seri (Dr.) Subramaniam Pillai 在近期多次申报持股变动。
earnings: 最新季度（截至 2025 年 3 月 31 日）营收 8791 万令吉，净亏损 3832.3 万令吉，净亏损率 43.6%。新闻显示 Q2 归属亏损 1731 万令吉。

Pestec Secures Interim Injunction Against SPECO Over Disputed US$10 Million Corporate Guarantee

recent_en: Pestec is facing a winding-up petition from Shandong Power Equipment (SPECO) over a US$10 million corporate guarantee, and has obtained an interim injunction to restrain enforcement. Meanwhile, the company appointed former Sarawak police commissioner Mancha Ata to its board, with several changes in director and substantial shareholder interests reported. The latest quarterly results show a net loss of RM17.31 million.
notable_en: The company appointed former Sarawak police commissioner Dato Mancha Anak Ata to its board.
The company obtained a High Court interim injunction restraining Chinese supplier SPECO from enforcing a US$10 million corporate guarantee.
The company clarified to Bursa regarding the winding-up petition by SPECO, stating it was not previously notified.
risks_en: SPECO has presented a winding-up petition against the company over a US$10 million corporate guarantee.
The company received a winding-up / receiver / restraining order / special administrator announcement.
Director and substantial shareholder Datuk Seri (Dr.) Subramaniam Pillai reported multiple changes in shareholding recently.
earnings_en: Latest quarter (ended 31 March 2025) revenue was RM87.91 million with a net loss of RM38.323 million, a net loss margin of 43.6%. News reports a Q2 loss attributable of RM17.31 million.
